svg.desc: King Abdullah Suburb in Jazan LOCATION Jazan City, KSA CLIENT Jazan Municipality, KSA COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2019 126 million USD DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Electrical Engineering Mechanical Engineering Project Overview The project covers the urban planning and design development for a 92 km2 (22,000 acres) residential, business, commercial and recreational city with high architectural requirements for buildings and landscaping. The project host 12,000 residents. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, data collection, project planning, site supervision and tender documents. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, landscape design, architectural design, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering.
